question: Can exact local nonmembership certify the derivative reciprocity functional, including the negative-discriminant high fibre, without Hilbert-symbol searches?
inputs: Retain the original derivative-reciprocity attempts, including the positive-discriminant gate failure and timeout. Use the same canonical class -disc(f) f'(theta).

Local Tate duality and self-orthogonality identify any nonmembership as a nonzero reciprocity functional. positive: One certified outside place closes the last local-image dimension when the known witness image has codimension one.
negative: If the class lies in every local image, it is a Selmer class and this reciprocal functional is zero on the local product. The boundary bit remains UNKNOWN.
replay: Retain full signatures, local point-basis indices, membership words or separating linear characters, norm identity and support bindings.
